reviews.text: They were very professional and welcomed our cat in the best possible way! Well done!

I left my cat Mike for over a month due to renovations. I was always updated with photos and videos showing that my cat was doing well. When I went to pick him up, he didn't want to come home, and I found him well-cared for, happy, and with a beautiful coat. I thank Marta and Elisabetta for their availability, kindness, and all the love and commitment they put into their work.

It's a fantastic place, impeccably managed by two very talented and experienced women. Whenever we travel for work or vacation, Dimensione Gatto is the best solution for our cat.

Thank you.

See you next time.
Thank you with all my heart!

I called this morning about my kitten, and while I understand that unfortunately it doesn't meet the hotel's standards, I can't ignore the fact that instead of recommending another establishment, or simply ending the conversation with a simple "Sorry, that's not possible," the phone hung up on me.

I also had a terrible experience.
I had previously had decent service, but in August 2024, it was terrible!
As I read in the last review, I also left my two cats at the hotel in August 2024. They contracted rhinotracheitis during their
stay at the hotel and then took them to my house for a week with their car sitter, Debora, who basically didn't even look at them for days because she didn't understand that they were seriously ill: cold, cough, fever, they weren't eating, and they had lost a lot of weight.
When I returned, I spent 15 days going back and forth to the Tibaldi clinic to get them treated, and my cat is still suffering from chronic cold problems.
If I had returned a few days later, I would have found them dead and they didn't even notice.
I also asked for a refund, but despite the owner's agreement, I never received a transfer.
NEVER EVER AGAIN
